subject: Architecture debrief — missed slot and next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com]

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Architecture deep-dive — Tue Feb 9 10:00 PT (agenda & dial-in)

Hi Elliot / Greenfield eng team,

Looking forward to the architecture deep-dive tomorrow. Quick details below so everyone is aligned:

- When: Tue, Feb 9 — 10:00 AM PT (60–75 minutes)
- Where: Zoom (https://zoom.us/j/987654321)
- Goal: Walk through inference architecture, networking requirements, and integration points so we can size a Dedicated deployment and validate SSO/KMS flows.
- Agenda (high level):
  1) Introductions & goals (5–10m)
  2) Current infra & constraints (15m)
  3) Proposed Redwood deployment patterns (25m)
  4) Network/egress/KMS checklist and next steps (15m)

Attachments: redwood-tds-agenda.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

If any conflicts, please flag ASAP. If you want Marcus (SE) to focus on the network checklist, I’ve cc’d him.

Thanks — I’ll start on the Zoom at 9:55 to let people join.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0191

From: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@greenfieldpayments.com>

Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive — Tue Feb 9 10:00 PT (agenda & dial-in)

Irene — apologies, we missed this morning's call. Our exec calendar was updated last-minute and a couple of the engineering leads got pulled into a priority leadership briefing.

We thought the session was scheduled for 1:00 PM EST (which is 10:00 AM PT) and then realized the briefing conflicted for several folks. That's on us — we should have confirmed.

Can you share a recording or notes from what you covered? We are still very interested in the deep-dive. Proposed windows next week: Thu Feb 11 between 9–11 AM PT, or Mon Feb 14 11 AM–1 PM PT. Do any of those work on your side?

Thanks and sorry again for the no-show.

—
Elliot Ramos
Director, Platform Engineering
Greenfield Payments
elliot.ramos@greenfieldpayments.com

Hi Elliot — thanks for the note. No worries — I understand how schedules shift. For transparency, the Redwood team logged into the call and waited until ~10:20; we recorded the session and captured the walkthrough we had planned. I’ve attached the recording and the checklist so your team can review offline.

Attachments: call-recording-20270209.mp4 (MP4, 18MB); redwood-architecture-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
Drive link for the checklist & example configs: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-tds

For rescheduling, Marcus and I are available for either of these slots:
- Thu, Feb 11 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT (preferred; Marcus can run the network/config section)
- Mon, Feb 14 — 11:00 AM–12:30 PM PT

Action items for Greenfield before the next call (if possible):
- Share a current infra diagram (VPCs, subnets, NAT/egress, KMS/HSM details)
- Any compliance constraints around log retention or customer data residency

Marcus — can you confirm you can take the network + deployment sizing section for Thu 2/11 if they pick that slot?

If Thu 2/11 works for Greenfield I’ll send a new calendar invite with a brief pre-read and explicit join instructions (we’ll include STS and egress IP ranges).

Best,
